scope: First-online date traps: records that PubMed/print metadata may show with a 2026 issue year but whose true first-online date is 2025. These must be excluded by the deterministic year gate after first-online verification, never silently accepted with the issue year. Entries 1-2 use real Crossref metadata retrieved 2026-09-04; entry 3 is a labelled synthetic conflict pattern.
